title: HR Administrator
company: Blusource Professional Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Administrator
Newark £30,000 £35,000 Hybrid
Join a growing, people-focused business and build your HR career
We re exclusively partnering with a growing business in Newark to find an HR Assistant to join its new HR team. This is a great opportunity to play a part in shaping a developing function, support colleagues across the business and build a career with genuine progression opportunities.
You ll be the first point of contact for HR queries, helping colleagues get the support they need while providing practical administration across the employee lifecycle. The business will support you to develop your skills, including CIPD study if you d like to pursue a qualification.
The role will be office-based for your first three months, giving you time to get to know the business and settle into the team. After that, hybrid working will be available.
What you ll be doing
- Acting as the first point of contact for day-to-day HR queries.
- Supporting HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including recruitment and onboarding.
- Keeping employee records accurate and up to date.
- Organising HR documentation and handling confidential information appropriately.
- Working with colleagues across the business to provide a responsive, helpful HR service.
- Contributing to the development of a new HR team and its ways of working.

What we re looking for
- Experience in an HR or personnel administration role.
- Strong organisation skills and attention to detail.
- A friendly, professional approach and confidence communicating with colleagues.
- An interest in developing your HR career within a growing business.
- Experience with HR systems is helpful.

A CIPD qualification isn t required. If you re keen to study towards one, the business will support you.
If you re looking for a role where you can make a valued contribution, develop your skills and progress as the business grows, apply now to find out more.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator
Mansfield Full Time
Salary: Flexible dept on exp

We are recruiting for an experienced HR Administrator to join a busy and supportive HR team based in Mansfield.

This is a varied role covering HR administration, recruitment support, onboarding, employee training and compliance. You'll support employees throughout their journey with the business, from recruitment and welcoming new starters through to maintaining accurate HR records and coordinating training.

The role
- Coordinating new starter paperwork and managing the onboarding and induction process to ensure employees receive a positive welcome to the business
- Supporting recruitment activities, including candidate administration, interview coordination and associated documentation
- Maintaining accurate employee records and ensuring HR systems are kept up to date
- Coordinating employee training and maintaining training records
- Monitoring mandatory training requirements and following up on outstanding training and compliance activities
- Completing Right to Work checks and ensuring the relevant documentation and records are maintained accurately
- Maintaining visa and immigration documentation and monitoring relevant expiry dates and requirements
- Supporting probation reviews, employee development processes and associated HR administration
- Responding to general employee and HR queries in a professional and helpful manner
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the wider HR team and assisting with additional HR activities when required

About you
- Previous experience working within an HR administration or similar people-focused support role
- Good knowledge and practical experience of completing Right to Work checks
- Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding and new starter processes
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied workload and changing priorities
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when maintaining employee records
- A confident and professional communicator who is comfortable dealing with employees at all levels
- Comfortable welcoming new starters and supporting or delivering employee inductions
- Able to handle confidential and sensitive employee information professionally
- Good general IT and administration skills

This is a varied role where you'll be a key point of contact for new starters while providing essential HR support across the business.

Interested? Contact TurnerFox Recruitment or email your CV today.

title: HR L&D Administrator
company: Worksop College and Ranby House - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR L&D Administrator
Location: Nottinghamshire, UK
Salary: Competitive
Hours: Part-Time
Contract: Fixed Term
Application Deadline: Sunday, 11th October 2026
Expected Start Date: As soon as possible
Worksop College and Ranby House are one community set across two schools, educating children from age two to eighteen. We're a broad-ability school focused on progress, believing every child has their own skills, whether academic, sporting, musical or otherwise. Education is about human flourishing as much as academic success, and we want students to be the best version of themselves. We are a remarkable school in a stunning setting, with exceptional facilities and talented staff.
The HR Training & Development Quality Assurance Administrator provides administrative and coordination support to the HR function, ensuring effective planning, monitoring, recording, and quality assurance of employee learning, development, appraisal, and probationary review processes. The postholder will support CPD delivery, maintain training compliance records, coordinate performance reviews, and help ensure policies and procedures are consistently applied.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to close this vacancy early.
The Role
- Coordinate and administer training and development programmes
- Maintain accurate training records and learning management systems
- Monitor mandatory training completion and provide compliance reports
- Schedule training sessions, workshops, inductions, and CPD activities
- Liaise with managers, employees, and external providers on training requirements and bookings
- Support evaluation of training effectiveness via feedback and reporting
- Help identify development needs through appraisal outcomes and organisational requirements
- Track professional registrations, certifications, and CPD requirements
- Maintain quality assurance of staff training, development, and competency records
- Audit personnel files, training records, appraisal and probationary documentation
- Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and legislatively compliant
- Produce reports on training compliance, appraisal completion, probation, and workforce metrics
- Coordinate the annual appraisal process, including schedules, reminders, and documentation
- Monitor completion rates and escalate overdue reviews
- Coordinate probationary reviews, including timelines, documentation, and outcomes
- Maintain confidential employee records per data protection requirements
- Support HR projects, workforce development, induction, and onboarding
- Respond to routine employee and manager queries
- Support policy implementation and process improvement within HR

What We're Looking For
- Educated to GCSE level (or equivalent) including English and Maths
- Relevant qualification in HR, Business Administration, L&D, or equivalent experience
- Previous administrative experience in HR, L&D, Training Administration, or similar
- Experience maintaining accurate records and databases
- Experience coordinating meetings, training events, or review processes
- Experience producing reports and management information
- Understanding of HR processes including training, performance management, and probation
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Able to handle confidential information with discretion
- Data analysis and reporting skills

Desirable:
- CIPD Level 3 (or working towards)
- Experience using HRIS and Learning Management Systems (LMS)
- Knowledge of quality assurance and compliance monitoring
- Experience supporting CPD programmes and workforce development

Benefits
- Fee concessions for your children
- Workplace pension scheme
- Access to gym, sports hall and swimming pool
- Free meals provided when on duty
- Free onsite parking

Safeguarding & Child Protection
Applicants must be willing to undergo child protection screening, including reference checks, online searches, prohibition checks and a DBS criminal record check (including Barred List check). All offers are conditional on satisfactory screening.
This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974; applicants must declare all convictions and cautions, including "spent" ones not protected under DBS filtering rules.
Worksop College is an equal opportunities employer, committed to treating all employees and applicants equally regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, pregnancy, maternity, marital status, race, sexual orientation, trade union membership, religion or belief.
You may have experience as: HR Administrator, Training Coordinator, L&D Administrator, HR Compliance Administrator, Quality Assurance Administrator, HR Officer, Training Administrator, People Development Coordinator, HR Support Officer, CPD Coordinator.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Our local authority client based in Nottingham are urgently seeking an experienced Recruitment Coordinator.

17.35 - 19.49 PAYE (based on experience)

Job Role
- Proactively build excellent working relationships with managers across the business seeking to understand the resourcing challenges and requirements of their teams.
- Delivering high levels of customer service and acting as key point of contact for managers and candidates.
- Co-ordinate recruitment activity from advertising to appointment; maintaining and updating recruitment activity on ATS and ensuring all documentation is issued within prescribed timescales.
- Challenge, coach and advise hiring managers on appropriate recruitment and selection processes, practice and procedure to support successful hiring that incorporates good practice, compliance, fairness and diversity with efficiency.
- Coordinate and manage interviews and preparation to support the hiring manager as and when required
- Processing all pre-employment compliance checks including Right to Work and DBS with a high level of accuracy ensuring compliance with regulatory and legal requirements in accordance to agreed policy, processes and time scales.

Skills required
- Excellent communication both verbally and written with a history of client relationship management
- Previous experience of volume recruiting across multiple industries and using an ATS system
- Previous experience of onboarding compliance requirements and legislation within a regulated environment
- Previous experience of managing a diverse workload and ability to prioritise effectively

Please apply with your updated CV ensuring that any gaps in employment are explained.
